{{Top|leg}}
'''Oplovis linens''' were a fine material produced on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Oplovis]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], later [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], from Oplovis [[Gaen Drommel]] ordered his executive officer, [[Gastos Niovi]], to personally pick up some of the fine lines for use in his personal quarters.<ref name="Warlords">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-3|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 3|nolive=1}}</ref>
